The Loop is a product of the collective work of students across the five Claremont Colleges. Created by Circuits, Internet, Media, and Software, The Loop has published three issues -- one per active semester -- two of which you can scroll through below.

This magazine was primarily meant to be humanitarian, platforming and dignifying student works that would otherwise be forever stuck in their files; however, it has developed into a more formalized production as the organization behind it - CIMS – has grown. As a Co-founder and quasi-Editor-in-Chief, I am incredibly proud of the momentum, content, and community this magazine and organization has fostered in such a short amount of time, allowing me and my peers to grow as both artists, organizers, and multimedia fanatics. In Spring 2026, I handed leadership off to underclassmen, as I graduate in December 2026. See more about CIMS [here](https://claremont.campuslabs.com/engage/organization/circuits-internet-media-software).
